name: smwmusic-dokapon-kingdom-spring-cave
title: Dokapon Kingdom - Spring Cave
description:
Track 01 of Dokapon Kingdom's OST. This theme plays inside Spring Cave. It's one of the better songs that play from that game (in my opinion at least). Best used for caves, preferably those with water as well. Could also work for nighttime levels. It can be used as an overworld cave map too.

(EDIT: Added a more lively echo since it wasn't really that good in the first version.)
